methodology: The complete 22-scenario Playwright application suite runs serially once per Chromium, Firefox and WebKit project in each standard and compact production build under /PokemonPedia/. Every scenario must pass with no skips, flaky retries or expected failures before this summary publishes. Offline-data scenarios combine browser offline mode with a test-only preview middleware that closes origin sockets; an independent Node fetch must reject. This prevents worker-side network access from bypassing browser offline emulation. The same-origin outage fixture relies on the configured single worker and always removes its marker. Tests include emulated touch, keyboard, large text, fallback media, collections/backups, forms, references, quiz, comparison, teams, invalid data/retries, offline eviction and explicit updates. Audio behavior uses a deterministic audio double. Durations are functional test timings, not decoding benchmarks or field performance. WebKit on Windows is a Playwright engine, not a certification of Safari or physical Apple devices.
fixes: Each page owns its URL parameter updates, preventing delayed search or import callbacks from modifying a different destination route.
Added a slow detail-chunk navigation regression and reliable origin-level outage fixtures for offline data tests.
Declared the incumbent dark native-control scheme so WebKit selectors remain readable without changing the application layout.
limits: Physical touch devices, screen readers, live audio decoding, complete-media performance, browser-minimum-version coverage, independent decode profiling, field metrics and public-host deployment remain pending.
